## Database gate

Official `vendor-0.2.16^{commit}` to `v0.2.17^{commit}` changes no file under
`backend/migrations/`, `backend/ent/`, or `backend/scripts/`, and changes no
`.sql` path. The database semantic report returned `database_changed=false`
with empty-manifest fingerprint
`e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`.
There is no new production DDL or DML for this official increment. Existing
Custom database exceptions are rebound to the exact v0.2.17 baseline. The
candidate final database boundary passed with the preserved Custom fingerprint
`40a0a1f1843c3b51566500b7533508e5d1222b1f4048a7a6adabacabc0ee31db`.
The four-tree upgrade report returned `database_changed=false` and the same
empty-manifest fingerprint shown above.

Before a host rollout, inspect migration state without changing the database:

```sql
SELECT version, applied_at FROM schema_migrations
WHERE version BETWEEN 242 AND 245 ORDER BY version;
```

Migrations 242 through 245 belong to the previous v0.2.16 release. A host
that has not applied them still needs separate backup-first migration review.
No production database statement was executed during this upgrade.

## Custom changes and semantic review

The official tag changes 153 paths, including Gemini 4 Argon, GPT-5.5
subscription retirement, Gemini compatible thinking, Responses `created_at`,
EasyPay confirmation, held refunds, and removal of Stripe `client_secret`
from the payment route. Forty official paths intersect the Custom delta and
44 changed paths have mapped Custom shadow implementations. Nine content
conflicts were resolved individually in the Gemini, gateway, payment, and
payment page paths. The retained group-model policy checks, Custom payment
channel routing, BEpusdt native API, subscription inventory and refund cycle
snapshot, and payment recovery path require focused regression evidence.
The pending refund path now rejects missing or mismatched held subscription
snapshots before querying the provider. A forced refund with no active
subscription records no held deduction, so a successful later confirmation can
recheck the subscription; a zero-day retry retains its prior rollback state.

## Validation

- Resolved all nine content conflicts by reviewing Custom and official behavior
  together; `git diff --cached --check` and the shadow map (179 mappings, 181
  source paths) passed.
- Focused Go `unit` tests passed for Gemini routing, model availability and
  retirement, mapped-model web search access, BEpusdt callback confirmation,
  payment order type, held refunds, callback fulfillment, and subscription
  inventory consumption. The refund suite also passed after the held-snapshot
  validation and retry-state correction.
- Frontend lint, typecheck, 30 critical Vitest files (609 tests), and production
  build passed. Payment view, Stripe recovery, and Custom fallback tests passed.
- Linux amd64 production-parameter backend build passed. The local full backend
  `go test -tags=unit ./...` run did not pass: three PgDumper cases could not
  find `sh` on the Windows PATH and passed when rerun with Git Bash available;
  the memory-threshold case passed on an isolated rerun; the isolated
  `TestOllamaProbeCallback_StaleLongDoesNotOverrideNewShort` still expected zero
  CAS updates but observed one. That test and its implementation are byte-for-
  byte identical to the official v0.2.17 source, so the inherited mismatch is
  recorded without changing official code. Exact candidate thin-bridge and CI
  gates remain in progress.
- The v0.2.17 candidate includes the merged control-plane correction from
  `main` commit `1c3778259bce9a2bcb709c0f798458772a562d35`; its source PR
  CI run `39470248027` passed boundaries, unit, real-container integration,
  build, frontend, lint, macOS shell, and PR validation. The upgrade candidate
  requires its own exact-tree boundary check and exact-Head CI before merge.

Repository publication does not establish production host migration, restart,
health, or live payment acceptance.
